\section{\texttt{InMemoryJobStore}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.jobs.InMemoryJobStore}\index{Classes!InMemoryJobStore}

Thread-safe, dict-backed job store.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
InMemoryJobStore(self) -> None
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Details}A lock guards every mutation so the store is safe to share across FastAPI \texttt{BackgroundTasks} (which may run on a worker thread) and request handlers. Stored results are deep-copied on the way in and out, so callers cannot mutate persisted state by accident.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}jobs.\allowbreak{}py:132}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/b6cbc710ffdfa5f26f700c999d594c67588c1e16/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/jobs.py#L132}{online}), class, module \cref{module:feedback_intelligence_agent.jobs}
